releases.name: Tamzin Twins: The Tyranny of Tyrek
Abashed
releases.summary:
Abashed is a 2.5D narrative-driven side-scrolling game that lets you explore the life of Issac, a man living with psychosis. One day waking up all alone, he sets out to find the truth behind his missing partner. On the way he finds himself needing to confront his deepest fears and the darkest secrets. 

Join Issac in this story of love, loss, fear, and acceptance. Reality is not what it seems.

releases.name: Prigod Idle
releases.summary: You've never experienced a running game on iPhone until you experience Fun Caveman Run.This caveman is crazy, and so is the game!

releases.name: Red Glare The Reckoning
releases.summary: Red Glare: The Reckoning is a fully standalone experience of Real Time Tactics game Red Glare. You do not need the original Red Glare to play. Whether you're a returning agent or a first-time recruit, this is a complete campaign with its own story.

releases.name: I Hate Scalpers
releases.summary: I just hate scalpers. So I made a game about bonking them so they don't come back! Figure out who the scalpers and sitters are and BONK THEM! Duel people in Cut The Line and be the hero the city.

releases.name: Block Guy
releases.summary: Block Guys, giant walking war machines built from colored blocks, are marching on your base. Slide their blocks with the mouse, line up three or more of a color to clear them, and drop the Bloquians riding on top to the ground. Call in fire from your base and pop PSI balloons for special powers.

releases.name: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones
releases.summary: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.

releases.name: Piratocon: Dig, Restore & Collect
releases.summary: A cozy first-person collecting game. Dig lost model ships out of a sunny beach dune, rebuild each one on the shelf of her kind aboard an old galleon and scrub her back to her true colours. No combat, no rush, just sand, sea and a collection that grows a little every day.

releases.name: Nozile
releases.summary: Catch and throw Javelin repeatedly! Calculate the angle to fire!

releases.name: Nine Provinces
releases.summary: Play the popular game My Sweet Dog by Mary.com on your phone and tablet computer. In the first level of this game, you'll be taking care of a playful puppy called Frodo. You learn what is important in the life of such a small pup. Because a dog can easily be your companion for 10 to 15 years, it's important to bring it up right. Give him food and water. Play with him and take him out for walks. Wash him and make sure he gets enough sleep. If you do well, your puppy will grow into a lovely, happy and healthy dog. In the next level you will be able to train him and win competitions with him. In the third level, he's too old for competing, and you will take it easier. If you do well, you'll win photos of your dog! The better you do, the more photos you will earn. In this game you'll learn a lot about dogs. It takes a lot of time to raise and to take care of dogs, but if you do it well, they will be true, loyal friends. In the accompanying film, you can see how the game works.

releases.name: Old Man's Sushi
releases.summary: LayerBall is a relaxing billard game for in between. But it's not one of a kind from whom already exists a lot of. It's a modification with an extended game play.Playing LayerBall means not playing on only one table as in a classical billard game. In LayerBall you can play on up to 5 different tables at the same time, each on top of each other.Every table has its own color and only balls of this color are allowed to be pocketed at this particular table.

releases.name: Floorball Manager
releases.summary: Take charge of a floorball club in 8 nations. Scout talent, build your lines and watch every shift on an animated rink. Chase titles, the Continental Cup and national-team glory or rebuild the world your way with the full editor.

releases.name: Kamikaze Aliens
releases.summary: Welcome to Kamikaze Aliens, a game with no big bosses or awe-inspiring enemies—just you, your ship, and an endless horde of aliens spawned from randomized spawners that will make you see stars at the slightest touch!

releases.name: Village in Bloom
releases.summary: Build a new life on Grandpa Rıza’s farm in this cozy, single-player farming adventure. Grow crops, care for animals, fish, cook, craft, and fulfill your neighbors’ letters and orders on the way to the village fair.

releases.name: Make it! Karaage
releases.summary: Get ready for a delicious karaage-making challenge! Make tons of karaage and watch your food cart prosper!

releases.name: Neuroflip
releases.summary: A card-based memory roguelike. Flip cards, remember where each face appeared and match pairs to defeat the Scribe, the Lady and the King. Missing on a new card is free; forgetting a pair you've already seen can cost you dearly.

releases.name: Trolley Dilemma
releases.summary: Face impossible dilemmas, meet strange characters, and discover how every switch changes the story. As the trolley keeps moving, your choices will decide who you trust, who you betray, and whether you become someone you never meant to be.

releases.name: Wickwood
releases.summary: A top-down pixel action game set across one long night. No crafting, no hunger, no inventory — just a bat, an axe, and a lantern burning down. The shrinking circle of light is the only clock you get. Find the parts for a dead car and drive out of Wickwood before the light goes.

releases.name: Wardspire
releases.summary: Defend the Nine Realms! Wardspire is a Norse tower defense built around a true counter system: 8 towers with 2 specializations each, 17 enemy types with resistances, 9 distinct realms, permanent progression in the Forge, and an endless mode.

releases.name: Suixun 01: The Last Customer
releases.summary: A linear paranormal mystery visual novel driven by dynamic text presentation. As timid but earnest rookie Mao-Rabbit, explore a mall after closing, rescue a customer the night guard cannot see, and uncover the anomaly rules already at work. No branches or bad endings.

releases.name: Mancalero
releases.summary: Mancalero is a marble board game fusing roguelike progression with deckbuilder strategy. Collect special marbles, unlock powerful Blessings, and defeat every table to become the true Mancalero.

releases.name: Axomorph Idle
releases.summary: Axomorph Idle, an idle biogentics game about evolving an axolotl from a cell to an ultimate axolotl form. Journey through an idle adventure through growth, evolve, rebirth, and ascension stages. If you love numbers, or axolotls, this game might be it for you. Try it out today for free!

releases.name: Project President
releases.summary: Run a country under pressure. Pass laws, negotiate Congress, survive scandals, control the media, face protests and win elections in a deep political strategy sim where every decision has consequences.

releases.name: Spincremental
releases.summary: Pull the lever, watch the reels, collect the symbols. Buy slot machines, unlock cursors, magnets, and cards that play for you, then upgrade everything through a deep skill tree. A cozy pixel-art incremental about turning one wooden slot into an automated jackpot empire.

releases.name: Stellar Nursery
releases.summary: Reignite a dead sun. Rebuild its worlds. Your only companion is P.O.R.T.I.A., a caretaker AI who has been alone for a very long time, and who remembers more than she should. A story rich idle game about grief, patience, and second chances, told over generations of stars.

releases.name: ALL-HU: Mahjong Puzzle
releases.summary: We make fun & educational Ipad apps for 1 - 4 year oldsMy First Words is a series of educational games for the youngest children. The games will help your child to learn new words in an entertaining and educational way.In this game you can play with 150 carefully selected playing cards picturing everyday items, each with a unique sound effect. A pleasant voice in the game, in either Swedish or English, asks where a specific item is on the game board and it's up to your child to point out the correct item. Each item has an exciting sound to listen at.You can also create customized cards with your own pictures, sounds and effects and use them directly in the game! This allows you to create a personal card collection of personal everyday items from your home, in a language of your own choice.Features:- Card pack with 150 cards picturing everyday items - Voices in Swedish and English for all cards- Make your own cards from your home enviroment with  unique pictures and sounds IN WHATEVER LANGUAGE YOU LIKE- Different gameboard sizes- Random or custom play- And more!A real fun way of learning new words for your child!If you like this game please leave a review and try the second game in the series, My First Words -learn 150 things to do. ****User Stories from the My First Words series****“The pictures are beautiful, the sound effects are great and the music and voices are of high quality. It is very fun to play together with my two and a half year old daughter! Try it”“My son and I have played this game for hours.  It is so easy and fun to learn new words. We love this game. Thanks!”“It is very fun to play the game and listen to the sound effects of the cards"”I would like to say how impressed I am with your product. My two-year-old son LOVES it, and in only a week or so he has evolved from just knowing a few words to understand more than 100!. I sincerely believe this is the BEST program for toddlers on the iPad. Now I will start to make custom cards for her""Great app! My 1.5 yr old loves it. It's been fun to watch his finger coordination improve together with her understanding for new words. The soundeffects are really funny!”

releases.name: Marble Stars
releases.summary: Marble Stars is a fast-paced 3D platformer where you roll, jump, and race through 55 levels of different difficulties, using special abilities along the way. Master each course, chase your best times, and earn medals as you improve.

releases.name: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
releases.summary: A cozy sudoku game for the end of the day, with a cat for company. Play thousands of hand-graded puzzles offline, or solve the Nightly — one shared puzzle a day, every day. Pick a lofi station, layer rain over it, and settle in. Every board is solvable by logic alone; not one needs a guess.

releases.name: Objecipher
releases.summary: A competitive team game of clever clues, questionable logic, and wildly different interpretations. Identify your team's objects before your opponents identify theirs.

releases.name: Relic Recoil
releases.summary: Cute looks. Serious firepower! Explore machine ruins with Ain and Granma in this survivor-style action game. Blast through hordes of machines and bring resources back to base to upgrade your favorite guns, abilities, and support drones. Shape your playstyle and push deeper with every expedition.

releases.name: Lucky Shot VR
releases.summary: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky Shot VR is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

releases.name: Camera 5
releases.summary: Five cameras. Five nights. One caretaker who's starting to notice too much. A slow-burn surveillance horror where the building lies to you — and the system does too.

releases.name: Warlapse
releases.summary: War isn't heroism — it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

releases.name: The Smiling Flesh
releases.summary: The Smiling Flesh is a tense, single-player survival horror where you play as a thief trapped in a decaying gothic mansion. Solve puzzles, explore forgotten halls, and outsmart a twisted entity that learns your movements. Find the treasure, or become the mansion's next victim.

releases.name: Cubus Tower
releases.summary: Cubus tower is a platformer game. Climb the Cubus tower and find what is waiting for you at its summit.

releases.name: Offworlders: Galactic Ventures
releases.summary: Top-down space trading and combat on a working frontier. Run cargo, hunt salvage, fight pirates, and build a corporation that survives twenty cycles of pressure from the Cryos Foundation, the Frontier Allegiance, and the Sable Syndicate.

releases.name: Compactor Baron
releases.summary: You're broke and the bills keep coming. Smash scrap into cubes, sell them, pay up. A short active incremental: aim, let the hammer swing, upgrade your tools, go bankrupt on purpose, and build a scrapyard that pays for itself.

releases.name: Find The Box
releases.summary: A slow, quiet first-person digging game. One million blocks, one box to find. Normal mode gives you a warmer/colder signal as you approach the box; Hard mode gives you nothing. Every hole you dig is saved, a clock tracks your run, and your best times are kept. No enemies, no pressure. Just dig.

releases.name: Souterrain
releases.summary: Roll the dice. Cheat fate. Break the house. Souterrain is a roguelike dice-and-card game where you manipulate colorful dice, build powerful combinations, and gamble everything on one more hand.

releases.name: Desktop Slime Graveyard: Tap Reaper
releases.summary: Race the fun Tiny Critter friends in over 20 challenging levels.Challenge your friends and family and collect all the cute tiny critters!
